chunks: So God gave them the reward of the world and a good reward of the Hereafter, and God loves the doers of good.

key_terms.ٱلْأَخِرَةِ: the Hereafter, the life to come
key_terms.ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ: the doers of good, those who excel in virtue

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's reward for those who do good?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Jaza' al-Amal* (reward for deeds), illustrating that divine favor encompasses both temporal blessings and eternal felicity for the *Muhsinin*. It underscores the continuity of God's love (*Hubb Allah*) as a spiritual reward that motivates believers to transcend mere obligation and strive for excellence (*Ihsan*) in their conduct.
